title: Aauniati Satrar Buranji
author: Prof. Tirthanath Sarma
genre: Monastic History & Royal Tai-Ahom Diplomatic Relations
description: Authoritative historical and institutional chronicle by Prof. Tirthanath Sarma examining the Sri Sri Aauniati Satra on Majuli island, documenting the royal visits, endowments, copper charters (tāmraphalī), diplomatic envoys, and ecclesiastical relations between the Tai-Ahom monarchs and the Vaisnavite pontiffs.
